text: REJECT: The patch replaces the fully qualified `CodeHealth.Core.Classification.SourceClassifier` with a bare `SourceClassifier` but adds no `using CodeHealth.Core.Classification;`, so it likely fails to compile (CS0103) under warnings-as-errors. I couldn't confirm this because the repo isn't available here, and an existing using directive would make it fine. The extraction itself preserves behaviour: the short-circuit order is the same, and `count` is decremented only for first-party files.
